title: Marig-on Marathon 2026 Review: Northern Samar's Eagles-Club 42K
meta_description: Marig-on Marathon 2026: September 20 in Catarman, Northern Samar. Full marathon from the Marig-on Norte Samarnon Eagles Club.
dek: Set for 20 September 2026 in Catarman, Northern Samar, this Eagles Club-organised marathon brings a full 42K to one of the Philippines' most under-represented provinces.
verdict: The Marig-on Marathon is a community-organised full marathon in Catarman — the capital of Northern Samar, one of the Philippines' least-visited provinces in the Eastern Visayas. Organised by the Marig-on Norte Samarnon Eagles Club (a civic organisation), it carries genuine grassroots character. September in Samar is the tail of the typhoon season. For runners wanting a Philippine marathon in a province that almost no other race reaches, this is a uniquely off-the-beaten-path pick.

sections.heading: Northern Samar: Off the Map
paragraphs: Catarman is the capital of Northern Samar — one of the Philippines' least-touristed provinces. [1] The Eagles Club is a civic organisation, giving the race community-purpose character. September conditions are warm and potentially wet.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: A community marathon in one of the Philippines' rarest race destinations. 20 September 2026 in Catarman. [1]

faqs.question: When is Marig-on Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: 20 September 2026 in Catarman, Northern Samar. It offers 42.2K, 21.1K, 10K, and 5K. Registration is listed as not yet announced. Marig-on Norte Samarnon Eagles Club organises the event. [1]
